name: UXtweak
description_en:
UXtweak is a product in the UX design category. Its directory profile covers User Research, User Journeys, Usability Testing, Unmoderated Testing, Screen Activity Recording, Prototyping, For Websites, For Mobile.

Additional listed capabilities include Heatmaps. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $108.0. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
